name: Bloom of the Heavens

angles.text: Nord'el represents a precious remnant of Kalimdor's sacred heritage and an uplifting sign that Elune watches over the kaldorei as they adapt to the loss of their immortality.
This mission links the bustling Alliance port of Menethil Harbor in the Eastern Kingdoms across the Great Sea to Auberdine and Darnassus in northern Kalimdor.
Herbalists and botanists will appreciate the rare recovery of Nord'el, a sacred flora thought lost for ages that requires cultivation in Darnassus.

faq.answer: Nord'el is a sacred plant long thought lost by the night elves. Its rediscovery and survival after many years make it a treasured symbol of Elune's divine favor and a testament to nature's resilience.

aliases: who gives bloom of the heavens
faq.answer: The quest is given by Sylessa in the Wetlands. She successfully retrieved the sacred bloom despite being ambushed and pursued by hostile murlocs, though the ordeal left her too exhausted to complete the journey herself.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Bloom of the Heavens?

faq.answer: Nord'el must be brought across the sea to Elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine, located along the coast of Darkshore. From Menethil Harbor, travelers take the boat directly to Auberdine.
faq.q: Where does Nord'el need to be delivered?

aliases: why is nord'el important to night elves
faq.answer: Elder Thundris Windweaver views the flower's survival as a rare beacon of hope during dark times. It serves as a sacred reminder of Elune's grace and the enduring spirit of the kaldorei to persevere after sacrificing their immortality during the Third War.
faq.q: Why is Nord'el so significant to the night elves?

faq.answer: Upon receiving the bloom in Auberdine, Thundris Windweaver arranges for it to be transported safely inland to Darnassus, where night elf botanists and priests can properly nurture and cultivate it.
faq.q: What will happen to the flower after reaching Auberdine?

aliases: how to get to auberdine from wetlands
faq.answer: Travelers can take the passenger vessel docking at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, which sails directly across the Great Sea to the docks of Auberdine in Darkshore.
faq.q: How do you travel from Menethil Harbor to Auberdine?

sections.body: In the marshlands of the Wetlands, Sylessa manages to recover a legendary flower known as Nord'el, braving an attack by vicious local murlocs. Exhausted from her perilous escape, she entrusts the recovered plant to an adventurer to carry it across the Great Sea to Auberdine. The boat departing from Menethil Harbor offers passage straight to Darkshore, bridging the Eastern Kingdoms with northern Kalimdor.
sections.title: A Perilous Retrieval

sections.body: Upon receiving Nord'el in Auberdine, Elder Thundris Windweaver reacts with astonishment, having believed the sacred bloom had vanished forever. For the night elves, who are still grappling with the sacrifice of their immortality following the Battle of Mount Hyjal, the miraculous survival of Nord'el shines as a blessing from Elune. Thundris prepares to send the delicate plant on to Darnassus, ensuring it will be cultivated and preserved for future generations.
sections.title: A Sign of Elune's Grace

summary: Bloom of the Heavens is a journey across the sea to deliver a miraculous night elf botanical relic called Nord'el. Thought lost for generations, the surviving bloom serves as a powerful symbol of Elune's grace and kaldorei resilience following the loss of their immortality.
attribution: In-game quest text: Bloom of the Heavens
